title: salix myrsinites subsp. serrata
intro: Salix myrsinites subsp. serrata, commonly known as Rock Willow, is a subspecies of shrub or small tree in the willow family (Salicaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rock Willow include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as salicylic acid, flavonoids, and tannins. These compounds contribute to the plant's ability to soothe and protect the body, making it a valuable resource in natural medicine.
